test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If cosalpha = (3)/(5) and cosbeta = (15)/(17) , then the value of sin(alpha + beta)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use standard **Pythagorean triplets**: (3, 4, 5) and (8, 15, 17).

For cosα = 3/5 → sinα = 4/5

For cosβ = 15/17 → sinβ = 8/17

Applying sin(α + β) = sinαcosβ + cosαsinβ ⇒ (4/5 × 15/17) + (3/5 × 8/17) = 60/85 + 24/85 = 84/85.

**∴ The correct answer is 84/85.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07e471dc186b22c8a4d5058379b5f82f17bbd7daff1cf79c92bd868526bd3366.png] 

**Given:** cosα = 3/5, cosβ = 15/17

**Formula Used:** sin(α + β) = sinα cosβ + cosα sinβ

⇒ sinα = √(1 − cos²α) = √(1 − (3/5)²) = √(16/25) = 4/5

⇒ sinβ = √(1 − cos²β) = √(1 − (15/17)²) = √(1 − 225/289) = √(64/289) = 8/17

⇒ sin(α + β) = (4/5 × 15/17) + (3/5 × 8/17)

⇒ sin(α + β) = 60/85 + 24/85 = 84/85

**∴ The correct answer is 84/85.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Addition Formulas

sin(A ± B) = sinA cosB ± cosA sinB and cos(A ± B) = cosA cosB ∓ sinA sinB.

Pythagorean Identity

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, which implies sinθ = √(1 − cos²θ) for acute angles.</p
